name: Chromatic Dragon, Gray
body:
LE dragon (air, fire)

BASE STATISTICS

Subpages

CR 6; Size Small; Hit Dice 7d12
Speed 40 ft.
Natural Armor +5; Breath Weapon cone, 2d8 fire plus sooty breath
Str 16, Dex 15, Con 14, Int 10, Wis 10, Cha 10

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate and tropical active volcanoes
Organization solitary
Treasure triple

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Adaptive Breathing (Ex)

A gray dragon does not require respiration, and is immune to effects that require breathing (such as inhaled poison). This ability does not grant immunity to cloud or gas attacks that do not require breathing.

Pyroclast (Su)

An old or older gray dragon can use its breath weapon to create a cloud of volcanic smoke and ash as a standard action that deals fire damage equal to the dragon’s hit dice to any creature inside it.

The cloud moves with the dragon and has a radius of 20 feet and lasts 3d4 rounds. Any creature that starts its turn inside the cloud takes damage, but can make a Reflex save for half. A strong wind, such as that created by a gust of wind, disperses the cloud in 1 round.

Smoke Form (Ex)

An ancient or older gray dragon can assume a smoky form as a move action, once per day. It can spend up to 1 minute per day per HD in smoke form. This time does not have to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments. A smoke form dragon can fly at its normal fly speed (but good maneuverability). The ability is otherwise similar to a gaseous form spell.

Smoke Vision (Ex)

A very young gray dragon can see perfectly in smoky conditions (such as those created by pyrotechnics).

Sooty Breath Weapon (Su)

Living creatures that fail their saves against the gray dragon’s breath weapon are tormented by burning eyes. This effect imposes a -4 penalty to AC and a -2 penalty on attack rolls for 2d4 rounds.

Spell-Like Abilities (Sp)

A gray dragon gains the following spell-like abilities, usable at will upon reaching the listed age category. Young—burning hands; Juvenile—pyrotechnics; Adult—steal breath; Old—ash storm; Ancient—pyrotechnic eruption; Great wyrm—scorching ash form.

Age Category	Special Abilities	Caster Level
Wyrmling	Adaptive breathing, immune to fire, vulnerable to cold	—
Very young	Smoke vision	—
Young	Burning hands	—
Juvenile	Frightful presence, pyrotechnics	—
Young adult	DR 5/magic, spell resistance	1st
Adult	steal breath	3rd
Mature adult	DR 10/magic	5th
Old	Pyroclast, ash storm	7th
Very old	DR 15/magic	9th
Ancient	Smoke form, pyrotechnic eruption	11th
Wyrm	DR 20/magic	13th
Great wyrm	scorching ash form	15th
